analysis.reasonEn: Maintained wait-and-see for the past 3 consecutive trading days. Today, RSI entered oversold territory at 28.0, continuing its decline from 51.2 five days ago. MACD histogram worsened to -6289.7746. ADX is at 15.2, indicating a no-trend phase. Current price of 211,250 KRW shows upside potential compared to the 52-week low of 94,500 KRW. Approaching the swing support at 189,200 KRW. Setting stop loss at 1.3 times ATR (12,884 KRW) would trigger below 189,200 KRW. Target set at swing resistance of 223,000 KRW, ensuring a risk-reward ratio of at least 1.5.
